document.title: Rules of Procedure of the OIC Executive Committee
document.purpose: Defines the organization, powers, meetings, procedures, and decision-making process of the OIC Executive Committee.

Summit.description: Conference of Kings and Heads of State and Government

Resolution.description: All resolutions, declarations, communiqués, and programmes adopted by the Summit or CFM.

Ten_Year_Programme_of_Action.description: Strategic programme adopted during the 3rd Extraordinary Summit.

Member_State.description: Any member state recognized under the OIC Charter.

OIC_Troikas.description: Current, previous, and succeeding Chairmen of both the Summit and CFM.

Executive_Committee.description: Executive body established under Articles V and XII of the Charter.

Meeting.description: Regular or Extraordinary session of the Executive Committee.

Secretary_General.description: Secretary General of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation.

Follow_Up.description: Monitoring implementation of Summit and CFM resolutions.

rules.title: Definitions
rules.purpose: Defines all important terms used throughout the Rules.

rules.title: Meetings

regular_meetings.scheduled_by: Committee in consultation with Secretary General

venue: Another location proposed by the Secretary General
rules.notification: Secretary General informs Committee members and all OIC Member States.

rules.title: Agenda
restrictions: Only matters related to Summit and CFM agenda.
Internal or bilateral disputes cannot be included without consent of concerned Member States.
rules.agenda_approval: Requires affirmative vote of two-thirds of Committee members.

rules.title: General Secretariat
responsibilities: Inform Member States about important developments.
Secretary General may make oral or written statements.

rules.title: Official Languages
languages: As defined in Article 38 of the OIC Charter

rules.title: Conclusion of Debates
decision_process: If consensus fails, affirmative vote of two-thirds majority.
rules.restriction: Committee decisions cannot contradict the Charter or Summit/CFM resolutions.

rules.title: Reports and Records
rules.annual_report: Submitted to CFM with implementation recommendations.

rules.title: Amendment of Rules
procedure: Shared with Member States at least four months before CFM.

committee_summary.primary_role: Monitor implementation of Summit and CFM decisions.
committee_summary.secretariat: Secretary General organizes and supports all Committee activities.
